d:
Just like how landscapes only feel beautiful when distant and unfamiliar,
and like the comfort of one's own space that is appreciated only upon returning from afar love, too, loses its apparent luster as time passes.
In a world where fleeting excitement morphs into love, and break-ups become more prevalent and easy,
I wish to love someone who values more the growth of love as time layers all the good and the bad into what that may seem dull.
It is not about staying the same as the beginning, but about evolving and growing together with no deceit.
What matters is that we are still together.
